name: timeout1.k
model:
@timeout(10000)

class TimeoutTest1 {
  x:Int
  y:Int

  req x >= 0

  req x <= 100

  req y >= 0

  req y <= 100

  req x + y = 50

  req x > y
}

main:TimeoutTest1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((TimeoutTest1 (mk-TimeoutTest1 (x Int)(y Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-TimeoutTest1 (sel-TimeoutTest1 TimeoutTest1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-TimeoutTest1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TimeoutTest1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TimeoutTest1 ((this Ref)) TimeoutTest1
  (sel-TimeoutTest1 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-TimeoutTest1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TimeoutTest1 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -----------------------------------
;   Getters for class TimeoutTest1:
; -----------------------------------

; --- getters for TimeoutTest1.x: ---

(define-fun TimeoutTest1!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-TimeoutTest1 this))
)

; --- getters for TimeoutTest1.y: ---

(define-fun TimeoutTest1!y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-TimeoutTest1 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-TimeoutTest1 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TimeoutTest1:
; -------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-TimeoutTest1 TimeoutTest1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TimeoutTest1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (TimeoutTest1!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (TimeoutTest1.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TimeoutTest1.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (TimeoutTest1!x this) 100)
)

(assert (! (TimeoutTest1.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TimeoutTest1.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (TimeoutTest1!y this) 0)
)

(assert (! (TimeoutTest1.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TimeoutTest1.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (TimeoutTest1!y this) 100)
)

(assert (! (TimeoutTest1.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TimeoutTest1.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (+ (TimeoutTest1!x this) (TimeoutTest1!y this)) 50)
)

(assert (! (TimeoutTest1.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TimeoutTest1.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (TimeoutTest1!x this) (TimeoutTest1!y this))
)

(assert (! (TimeoutTest1.inv6 1) :named _xkassert6))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-TimeoutTest1 const-1-TimeoutTest1))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-TimeoutTest1 () TimeoutTest1
  (mk-TimeoutTest1 26 24))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (<= (y (sel-TimeoutTest1 (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-TimeoutTest1 (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (y (sel-TimeoutTest1 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (x (sel-TimeoutTest1 (select heap 1)))
              (y (sel-TimeoutTest1 (select heap 1))))))
  (= a!1 50)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-TimeoutTest1 a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (> (x (sel-TimeoutTest1 (select heap 1)))
   (y (sel-TimeoutTest1 (select heap 1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-TimeoutTest1 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-TimeoutTest1 (mk-TimeoutTest1 26 24))))
